newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Police said that over the last years some four to five billion forints of illicit income left the country.
- Flat owners can apply for 60,000 forints for thermal insulation from the environmental fund.
- The telecommunications watchdog called on mobile phone and pager operator companies to publish the list of their subscribers, in line with their concession contracts.
- The Tax Office has asked for supplemetary information from 73,000 small firms which submitted low income figures for last year.
